55/S0.subgoal: Explain the concept and purpose of the 3D graphics pipeline.

55/S1.subgoal: Describe the five stages of the 3D graphics pipeline and the coordinate systems involved.

55/S2.subgoal: Identify the challenges and broad categories of 3D object representation.

55/S3.subgoal: Explain point sample rendering as a representation technique.

55/S4.subgoal: Describe boundary representation techniques, including mesh and spline representations.

55/S6.subgoal: Describe specialized techniques for representing photorealistic objects.

55/S7.subgoal: Summarize the key concepts of the 3D graphics pipeline and object representation.
